title: UserSelectedCountermeasure
description: Schema for MEDIATE Message M6. This message publishes the countermeasure selected by the user from the Dashboard to the Orchestrator and then to the Policy Manager.

type.description: NGSI-LD entity type. It has to be userSelectedCountermeasure.

timestamp.description: Property. Date and time at which the user selected the countermeasure.

event.description: Relationship. Event entity for which the countermeasure was selected.

selectedCountermeasure.description: Relationship. Countermeasure entity selected by the user.
